links.outcome: Readability of chatbot responses to restorative dentistry questions (Flesch Reading Ease, Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level)
links.effect: No significant differences in readability among chatbots (p > 0.05); readability generally above recommended levels for patient education materials.
links.quote: However, the readability of responses was generally above recommended levels for patient education materials.

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates the accuracy, readability, reliability, and consistency of multiple commercial LLMs on restorative dentistry questions without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
